name: Zakuryn the Sculptor

abilities.name: Daedric Bolt
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack where Zakuryn the Sculptor tosses a magical bolt from his hand, dealing low frost damage.

abilities.name: Daedric Swell
abilities.description: Zakuryn the Sculptor raises his staff and fires off ethereal skulls from it, hitting you in rapid succession. This ability can be interrupted.

abilities.name: Daedric Swarm
abilities.description: Damage tick from "Daedric Swell", each dealing moderate magic damage.

abilities.name: Daedric Siphon
abilities.description: Zakuryn the Sculptor channels a necromantic beam to you using his staff, draining your health and healing him in return. Each tick deals moderate magic damage.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Zakuryn the Sculptor's body slowly evaporates, and he teleports across the arena.

abilities.name: Summon Banekin
abilities.description: A dark pool of energy appears in the floor of the arena, which conjures a group of Banekin.

abilities.name: Ward
abilities.description: When Zakuryn the Sculptor reaches 40% health, he applies a magical shield over himself and becomes invulnerable. To remove this shield, his Flesh Abomination must be lured over to him and goaded into striking him, which will break the shield and stun him for a moment. A previous hint about this is that the abomination's strikes defeats the summoned banekin.

abilities.name: Absorb
abilities.description: Killing the abomination first causes its essence to be sent back to Zakuryn the Sculptor, which heals him for half of his starting health and enrages him.
